item.title: SHAFT 0.75.0
item.description:
• Meetings on iPhone and iPad: record a meeting from the Meetings screen (the microphone; it keeps recording with the screen locked). A phone call or Siri leaves a marked gap and the recording resumes.
  • The recording is sent to your SHAFT server when you stop, or the next time you open the app if it could not be sent.
  • iPhone and iPad have the same Meetings screens as the Mac: transcript, naming voices, account, Copy Reference.
  • Meeting recording, voice mode and read aloud no longer compete for the microphone.
